name: VETTING
summary: A method, with a Python package, in which a second model checks each AI reply against a policy the learner never sees, before the learner sees the reply.

license.note: The package is MIT; the paper is open access under CC BY 4.0.

access_note: The Python package calls a model provider on your own key.
cite: Li, H., Zhang, S., & Botelho, A. F. (2026). VETTING: A dual-LLM framework for in-loop safety verification via policy isolation in educational AI. Computers and Education: Artificial Intelligence, 11, 100646. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.caeai.2026.100646

fits.how: The harness runs it in JavaScript: the graph's VETTING step and checkReply review each reply against the guideline or answer key and the teacher's settings.

connect.note: In the core, with no download: the graph's VETTING step and checkReply review a reply against the answer key or guideline before a learner sees it. Its authors' study is about review of replies, not about what learners learn with it here.
